svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Retrieval augmented generation on AWS
svg.desc: Retrieval augmented generation on AWS. 10 components in 4 groups. Connections: Users to Amazon Cognito (sign in); Users to Amazon API Gateway (question); Amazon Cognito to Amazon API Gateway; Amazon API Gateway to RAG agent; RAG agent to Amazon Bedrock (prompt and context); RAG agent to Vector index (retrieve); Documents to Ingestion function (ObjectCreated); Ingestion function to Amazon Bedrock (chunks); Ingestion function to Vector index (index); RAG agent to Amazon CloudWatch; Ingestion function to Amazon CloudWatch.

text.tspan: Documents are chunked and embedded into OpenSearch Serverless; an AgentCore agent retrieves context and answers with a Bedrock model
